# Copilot repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root first, it is the canonical standing-instruction file for this repository and applies to you as much as to any other agent. Read `SPEC.md` for technical implementation detail and `PRD.md` for requirements and acceptance criteria before starting any task.

Path-specific instructions for this repository live in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` and apply automatically based on the files you're editing, do not duplicate their content here.

If any instruction in this file ever conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` is correct, this file is a pointer to it, not a second source of truth.
